name: Mika Drew
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: Mika charges hospital jobs by the rail and domestic jobs by the hour. A squeak at night feels very different in those two accounts. Mika is collecting real complaints before bidding for the next ward contract. Wednesday often includes a stop at the public end of the South Shore boardwalk, where Mika checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: The rail squealed when I moved it and woke three people. I returned after supper to quiet the other rails too. A day's work can have a different ending from the one on the invoice.
appearance: Mika is easy to recognize by short black hair swept back and an aquiline nose and a square chin. Usually dressed in an old plum windbreaker with a pen clipped inside the neckline, Mika presses the lips together to keep a smile in when listening.
personality: Mika has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To quiet the rails on the adjoining beds before the next night shift.
family: Greta Hassan is Mika’s second cousin. Mika saves a place. Greta chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The returned daughter*, Greta says, “I am the half sister born later. Today's visit is the first time anyone explained the family photograph with a cut edge.”
connections: Bea Rial. The last obstacles between the bed and the view are a sticky rail and a pane with an old handprint.

reactions.situation: A relative wants the sunrise streamed to a phone
reactions.response: Mika asks the patient whether they want a camera in this particular morning.

reactions.situation: A stranger offers money to cut ahead of an exhausted neighbor
reactions.response: Mika tells the stranger when the next opening is, then stays with the neighbor until their turn comes.
